item.description:
本期收录 10 篇论文。

  1. STARS-GS: Structure-Aware Regularized Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Aerial Surface Reconstruction — STARS-GS：用于大规模航空表面重建的结构感知正则化高斯泼溅 (95/100)
  2. EarthLD: Towards Unified Open-World Landslide Understanding via Vision-Language Guided Diffusion Models — EarthLD：基于视觉语言引导扩散模型的统一开放世界滑坡理解 (95/100)
  3. Exploring the Potential of Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training for Multi-Source Remote Sensing Data — 探索对比语言-图像预训练在多源遥感数据中的潜力 (90/100)
  4. Do LLMs Know Your Neighborhood? Auditing LLM Priors for Neighborhood-Level Mobility Prediction and Structural Alignment — LLM了解你的社区吗？审计LLM先验知识在社区级移动性预测与结构对齐中的表现 (90/100)
  5. Agentic Multimodal Models for Environmental Hyperspectral Unmixing — 用于环境高光谱解混的智能体多模态模型 (88/100)
  6. Genesis: A Generative Engine for Hierarchical Satellite Image Synthesis — Genesis：用于分层卫星影像合成的生成引擎 (85/100)
  7. SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning — SimCRAFT：通过合成轨迹与上下文检索增强微调蒸馏遥感智能体 (85/100)
  8. SMS-Diff: Physics-aware spectral-spatial diffusion for unified geospatial multi-modal reconstruction — SMS-Diff：用于统一地理空间多模态重建的物理感知光谱-空间扩散模型 (80/100)
  9. Segmentation-guided and attention-enhanced GAN for SAR image restoration under multi-type interference — 分割引导和注意力增强的GAN用于多类型干扰下的SAR图像恢复 (80/100)
  10. SPAR: Enhancing Industrial-Scale Generative POI Recommendation via Real-World Spatial Perception — SPAR：通过真实世界空间感知增强工业级生成式兴趣点推荐 (80/100)
